card.name: Chinese text titles ending in treatise or sutra
card.fires_on: The final Chinese character of a Buddhist text title, such as 論 (treatise) or 經 (sutra), written after a romanized Sanskrit title. Weaker on the third digit of a year such as 1800 or 1812.

modes.label: Buddhist title characters
modes.description: The closing character 論 or 經 in a Chinese-script title that follows a Sanskrit title.
modes.example: Abdhidharma-kośa-bhāsya 倶舍<<論>>, the Triṃśikā Vij

modes.label: Digits inside years
modes.description: A digit within a year in the 1700s or 1800s, in historical text.

card.plain: It fires at the end of Chinese Buddhist text titles, like 論 or 經, and weakly on digits in old years.
